newsitem.title: USA: Ziegler sees matching Q4 1995 as challenge.
newsitem.headline: Ziegler sees matching Q4 1995 as challenge.

text.p: Ziegler Cos Inc said it will be a challenge to equal last year's fourth quarter profit level.

The financial services concern said business looks strong going into the fourth quarter. But it added, "It will be a real challenge to equal last year's exceptionally strong fourth quarter profitability."
The company reported third-quarter profits of $0.46 per share, up from $0.32 per share.
In the fourth quarter of 1995, it posted profits of $2.4 million, of $1.04 per share, on sales of $18.3 million.
